mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it showed how nerves and blood routes connect the regions and support muscles.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the repaired segment and then the covering felt a little repetitive; both were the only available combinations.

surprise.text: The diaphragm was a useful landmark separating the chest from the abdomen, while the food pipe, nerves and vessels cross between them.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the lymph-network fitting mostly followed the named pairing and the earlier vein connection rather than requiring a new inference.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems work together. This ending connected them clearly, but the final fittings were predictable.
